text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
Born into a family of athletes, Duramente 
had inherited an abundance of talent.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
She holds her parents up as her ideal, and has thrown herself 
into training wholeheartedly since she was small.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
Even so, she believes she is still 
far from her parents' strength.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
There is one more horsegirl she looks up to. 
Air Groove, the "Empress"--she and Duramente 
studied at the same racing school years ago.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
Her parents and Air Groove both have high hopes for her. 
To answer them, she has to win, without fail.
